row:
Located in Calgary, Alberta, Canada, Moore Equine is one of the most esteemed general and referral centers in all of Canada. Our case load is primarily equine, with additional work in  bovine, camelid, and small ruminants. We provide general veterinary medical services on both an ambulatory and in-hospital basis, seeing hunters, jumpers, western performance, draft horse and all other disciplines, with over 9,350 appointments and 500 surgeries performed each year. At Moore Equine Veterinary Centre, every animal is important to us, as well as every owner, whether you have just purchased your first horse, you are a trainer, or you own a stable. The combination of medical expertise, personalized treatment and cutting edge technology combine to create an unmatched standard of care.

Make sure to check in at our YouTube channel for updates and education material.
